_comment: App Builder workstream D (app databases, env/secrets, migrations): the CloudNativePG operator, and what the nextjs-web@2 template adds to every app image (pg, node-pg-migrate and their dependencies, from templates/nextjs-web-v2/package-lock.json and migrate/package-lock.json). Folded by H into licenses/components.tsv, THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.md and sbom.cdx.json. The PostgreSQL operand image is NOT shipped: choosing it is an owner decision (docs/components/app-databases.md 'Licence'), so it is listed as bundled 'no' for the record.

components.name: cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg (operator)
components.note: image ghcr.io/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg:1.30.2@sha256:f96f6be3d81ec93819b443c665c575c609342fca840df90d4d87dae314a5b913 (scripts/cnpg/install.sh); Go modules all Apache-2.0/MIT/BSD/ISC (syft SBOM 2026-11-27); base gcr.io/distroless/static-debian13 adds only data packages (base-files, netbase GPL-2; ca-certificates MPL-2.0/GPL-2+; tzdata public domain), no program or library

components.name: cloudnative-pg/postgresql operand image (candidate)
components.note: NOT shipped: a Debian 13 userland (bash, coreutils, grep, sed, tar, gzip, dpkg, apt, gnupg GPL-2/3; glibc, libgcrypt and others LGPL; perl GPL/Artistic) around PostgreSQL. Owner decision pending; the chart refuses to render the app clusters until osUI.software.databases.imageName is set

components.name: pg (npm, in app images)
components.note: with pg-pool, pg-protocol, pg-types, pg-connection-string, pg-cloudflare, pgpass, postgres-array/bytea/date/interval, xtend (MIT), pg-int8, split2 (ISC)

components.name: node-pg-migrate (npm, in app images under /app/migrate)
components.note: with yargs, jiti and their dependencies (MIT/ISC) and glob, minimatch, lru-cache, minipass, path-scurry (BlueOak-1.0.0, attributed in templates/nextjs-web-v2/migrate/NOTICE)

components.name: glob, minimatch, lru-cache, minipass, path-scurry (npm, in app images under /app/migrate)

attributions: glob, minimatch, lru-cache, minipass, path-scurry - BlueOak-1.0.0 - Isaac Z. Schlueter and Contributors, https://github.com/isaacs (templates/nextjs-web-v2/migrate/NOTICE)
